description: This file contains a shell script used for performance testing of git-grep's regex engines with various options and configurations. It defines tests for different pattern types and grep engines, managing prerequisites and threading options, and comparing output results across different engines to ensure consistency.

methods.description: Initializes a large repository for performance testing.

methods.description: Prepares the working tree for testing.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites required for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks whether specific prerequisites are met before running tests.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified options and pattern.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to verify consistency.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expectation that should succeed.
